Rubio responds to Maduro’s military mobilisation, makes big revelations on Sudan violence, Ukraine
videos
Published on Nov 13, 2025 10:53 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio holds a news conference addressing global and domestic issues, including the aftermath of the recent terror attack in Delhi, U.S. diplomatic engagement with Russia on the Ukraine war, and key partnership initiatives with international allies. Rubio responds to media questions on India-Pakistan tensions, emphasizes support for India's terrorism investigation, and outlines the U.S. approach to ongoing regional crises. He highlights continued American diplomatic efforts, the importance of open communication with major powers, and the United States’ commitment to alliances and measured responses in global affairs.
